name: Tether
author: Erin Carter
description: A harbour at night: a waterfront of moored lights strung along the far shore just above the waterline, each glowing buoy- and dock-lamp throwing a long shimmering reflection straight down the black water. The lamps bob gently on the swell and their mirrored streaks break into horizontal ripple bands as the surface stirs — a slow living current of leashed embers on dark glass.

params.label: Swell speed
params.effect: Rate of the lamps' gentle bob and the ripple shimmer travelling down their reflections — 0 stills the harbour to glass, high keeps the surface stirring.

params.label: Reflection length
params.effect: Length and strength of the water reflections — 0 leaves just the lamps and a glint at the waterline, 2 streams long luminous columns down the whole water.

params.label: Lamp glow
params.effect: CSS-pixel radius of each lamp's glow core, from pinprick harbour lights to broad lanterns.

params.label: Lamp density
params.effect: How many lamps line the shore — low scatters a sparse few, high strings a dense lit waterfront across the whole frame.
